main.description: One folder of the actor's own file organisation (step3 Phase 6). Actor-specific state shared across the actor's devices; not part of any op-log. One folder is one record (rkey = folder id, UUID) so that folders created on two devices offline are both kept. The tree, name-collision renames and orphan handling are derived on read.

name.description: Display name. Unique among siblings; collisions arising from sync are resolved by renaming the later one.

parent.description: Parent folder id (UUID). Absent for a top-level folder.

createdAt.description: Creation time (ISO 8601). Orders folders when a name collision is resolved.
